text:
sam: Heads-up from design review: the new prompt-sets regression diff panel feels cramped on small screens. Users reported the scorecard actions overlap with the diff header. Screenshot: https://screens.redwood.ai/ps-diff-compact.png

lia: I saw that too in the prototype. We could collapse the diff header into a single line with a dropdown for actions on mobile widths. Keep primary actions (Approve, Reject) visible.

otto: accessibility note: if we collapse, ensure the dropdown is keyboard-accessible and labelled (aria-label) and that the opened state announces the actions. Also keep a visible focus ring on the compact header.

cara: copy nit: "Approve" vs "Approve run" — users in testing prefer the verb + context. Use "Approve run" for single-run actions and "Approve selected" for bulk.

sam: good call. UX question: when approving from the diff panel, should the panel close automatically or remain open with a snackbar undo? Research said some users want to inspect subsequent diffs quickly.

lia: let's keep it open by default but add a small toggle in settings "Close panel after action" for power users. By staying open we can also auto-focus the next unchanged test if we're in a list view.

otto: implementation details: live region message on approve: "Approved test run \u2014 Undo" (assertive). Debounce opens to avoid announcing when users arrow through rows.

cara: tiny accessibility tweak: buttons in the compact header must be >=44px tappable on touch. Also ensure color contrast meets AA.

sam: action items: lia -> update Figma with collapsed header + dropdown; otto -> add a11y PR spec for aria-live and focus ring; cara -> finalize microcopy tokens; sam -> add settings toggle and write acceptance criteria.

ux-bot: created task PROD-3599 "Compact diff header: collapse + a11y + copy" (https://tasks.redwood.ai/3599) assigned to lia, otto, cara

sam: will post the updated Figma link shortly. Thanks! :sparkles:
